title: We’re All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner!
caption: We’re All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! (V)
game_text:
USED: Play at the start of your activate phase. When you activate Force this turn, use your opponent’s Force icons instead of your own.
LOST: Cancel Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy.
lore: Trash compactors crush waste before it is jettisoned into space. Magnetically sealed to prevent leakage. R2-D2 saved the day by shutting down compactor 3263827.
